# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are developed against the latest code on `main` and released as
the next stable version.

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| Latest stable release (`main`) | Yes |
| Pre-releases (`-beta.N`, `-alpha.N`) | No: upgrade to the next release of that channel or to stable |
| Older stable releases | No, unless explicitly listed here |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues or pull requests.**

Use the repository's **Security** tab and select **Advisories → Report a
vulnerability** to send a private report to the maintainers. Include the
affected version/commit, impact, reproduction steps, and any suggested
mitigation. Do not include live credentials, private keys, or customer data.
